messages:
Sofia: FYI — proposing a change to audit-view RBAC + timeboxed SIEM export flow. high-level ask: fine-grained 'view-audit' role, KMS-wrapped exports, enforced 7-day TTL for temp exports. Thoughts?
Omar: sounds reasonable. main risk is 3rd-party analyst access and CMK unwrap approvals. How are we gating unwrap?
Sofia: plan is JIT unwrap via sec-bot with approval ticket + short-lived signed URL, KMS envelope keys rotated weekly.
Karen: prefer not to rotate weekly. weekly rotation means reencrypting archives; can we rotate the CMK but keep DEKs stable for 30 days?
Sofia: yeah we can do CMK rotation with DEK wrapping; need to update the playbook though.
Dave: for RBAC, instead of a new global role, can we use resource-scoped entitlements (project-level view-audit) + audit justifications stored on ticket?
Omar: +1 resource scoping. Also need logging for who requested exports — add audit fields to the export record: actor, reason, ticket_id, expiry.
sec-bot: deploy-bot: New export request created (id: exp-2026-03-15-42) by Sofia; awaiting approver.
Sofia: example policy snippet:
```json
{
  "Version": "2022-10-01",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"audit:CreateExport","Resource":"arn:redwood:project:${project}:export/*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:RequestTag/ticket":"true"}}}
  ]
}
```
Karen: we need to add `kms:Encrypt/Decrypt` only for proxy service principal, not humans.
Dave: agree. proxy will unwrap and stream to approved S3 with KMS SSE-KMS. ephemeral S3 presigned URL TTL = 1h by default.
Omar: retention question — do we enforce 90 days on the export bucket or TTL metadata + lifecycle? if we do lifecycle, need to ensure forensic holds can override.
Sofia: forensic-hold workflow via legal flag in ticket; hold lifts require legal approval. hold should prevent lifecycle delete.
Karen: ok - update runbook + add unit tests for lifecycle rule simulation.
Sofia: I'll draft PR with config + playbook, will ping for reviews.
Omar: thx — can you include an operations runbook section with commands for emergency revoke/unwrap?
Sofia: will do.
Karen: :thumbsup:
